text:
Chloe (Sales): quick handoff for Meridian Clinics (acct MID-782). signed this am. ARR $72k, pilot for 90 days. go-live target 2026-06-10. primary POC: Arman Seyed (IT Architect).

Chloe (Sales): must-haves flagged by customer: EU-only storage, Okta SSO, weekly audit log exports, and HSM-backed KMS. they expect <100ms 95p for chat searches.

Miguel (CS): i'll take onboarding lead. will set tech kickoff with Arman. need confirmation on private control-plane vs. dedicated-hosted. anyone from infra available?

Priya (CS Lead): renewal opportunity at 9 months if pilot succeeds. label as "GTM expansion" — security add-ons likely. risk: if qual drops after quantization they will pause. add pre/post-quant baseline in runbook.

Devon (Eng): i can be infra owner. pls share sample traces and representative prompt set. question: do they require deterministic outputs for certain flows?

Chloe (Sales): yes — some internal compliance queries need deterministic responses. contract appendix has sample payloads and a scale estimate: ~90 reqs/min peak, avg token count ~45. link: https://redwood.internal/contracts/MID-782/appendix.pdf

Rina (Support): i'll take initial 30-day on-call rotation and ops runbook. will build PD schedule and escalation matrix to Eng/SRE. tag me on tickets.

legal-bot: Provided SOC2 summary & KMS policies to thread. https://redwood.internal/security/summaries/MID-782

Miguel (CS): owners + next steps: Miguel = onboarding; Devon = infra triage; Rina = support; Priya = renewal/expansion. i'll create onboarding doc and invite Arman for tech kickoff.

Chloe (Sales): intro email sent to Arman, cc legal and security. Arman will share SAML metadata and network CIDR for VPC peering.

Miguel (CS): onboarding checklist i'm adding to the runbook:
```
- create org + staging env
- provision VPC peering and subnet allowlist
- provision HSM KMS and retention policy
- validate Okta SSO (SAML cert + ACS URL)
- deploy private control plane (staging)
- baseline perf tests: 95p latency and throughput
- upload prompt set for baseline quality eval
- configure weekly audit export job
```

Devon (Eng): opening infra ticket INF-6110. can someone upload 100 anonymized dev requests to the ticket so i can reproduce tail latency?

Chloe (Sales): uploading redacted dev sample now and Arman will dump a sanitized trace by EOD.

Priya (CS Lead): add a pre-quant FP baseline. we should not enable aggressive 4-bit quantization until quality checks pass. grade on exact-match and semantic-similarity thresholds.

Miguel (CS): agreed. adding weekly regression checks and immediate alert: latency > 95ms at 95th pct triggers action. also alert on token-usage anomalies.

Rina (Support): i'll create two runbook pages: "initial ramp (0-7d)" and "stabilization (8-30d)" with runbook playbooks and PD handoff steps. linking to PD rotation doc.

Devon (Eng): once samples are in i'll repro on dedicated pool and post perf numbers. if we exceed targets, options: tailored batching, prefix caching, or move to higher-priority routing.

Chloe (Sales): legal also requested weekly audit export and retention policy confirmation. @legal-bot any blockers?

legal-bot: No blockers. shared KMS/HSM retention guidance; customer asked for 7-year audit retention — legal will follow up with contract amendment notes.

Priya (CS Lead): action list (owners): Miguel create runbook + schedule kickoff (Miguel). Devon open INF-6110 + repro (Devon). Rina build PD + support runbook (Rina). Chloe coordinate legal amendment (Chloe). follow-up meeting 1 week after tech kickoff.

Miguel (CS): scheduled tech kickoff: Wed 2026-04-06 09:00 CET. invite sent to Arman, Chloe, Devon, Rina, Priya.

Chloe (Sales): thanks all :thumbsup: — i'll close sales handoff once runbook links are pasted.

Rina (Support): acknowledged. prepping SLA summary draft for the kickoff.

Devon (Eng): INF-6110 created: https://redwood.internal/infra/INF-6110. will post initial repro by Mon EOD.

Miguel (CS): closing note  customer is strategic for our healthcare vertical play. high chance to expand to 2 additional clinics if pilot meets latency and compliance. prioritize perf + auditability.
